reporter.title: SEDM: Scalable Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents

rows.notes: LoCoMo, five categories as labelled in SEDM Table 1 (Single Hop, Multi-Hop, Open Domain, Temporal, Adversarial); §4.1 says ~200 questions per dialogue and lists only four types. Backbone gpt-4o-mini for all experiments (§4.1). Question count, retrieval budget and embedder for LoCoMo are not stated. BLEU-1 and F1 per category only; no overall score. Values equal A-Mem (arXiv 2502.12110) Table 1 GPT-4o-mini rows rounded to one decimal, but SEDM's category labels differ from A-Mem's column labels (e.g. the 25.0/19.8 pair is A-Mem's first column); SEDM does not say the numbers were copied, so run_by is left null.
